title: fix(ui): prevent scroll-to-bottom button from shrinking transcript

nodes.body:
Codex review: needs maintainer review before merge. _Reviewed July 11, 2026, 6:33 PM ET / 22:33 UTC._

**Summary**
Positions the Control UI scroll-to-bottom affordance as a zero-height absolute overlay and adds a browser layout regression test.

PR surface: Source +6, Tests +59. Total +65 across 2 files.

Reproducibility: yes. there is a high-confidence reproduction path: on current main, scroll away from the latest message so the conditional flex wrapper appears and compare the transcript/composer geometry before and after. The PR supplies a focused browser test for that path, although this review did not independently execute it.

**Review metrics:** none identified.

**Merge readiness**
Overall: 🦞 diamond lobster
Proof: 🦞 diamond lobster
Patch quality: 🦞 diamond lobster
Result: ready for maintainer review.

Overall follows the weaker of proof and patch quality, so missing proof can cap an otherwise strong patch.

**Next step before merge**
- [P2] This member-authored, maintainer-labeled PR already contains the narrow repair and should proceed through normal exact-head review and merge gating rather than an automated repair lane.

**Security**
Cleared: The diff only changes local CSS and a mocked browser regression test, with no dependency, workflow, secret, permission, network, publishing, or executable supply-chain surface.


<details>
<summary>Review details</summary>

Best possible solution:

Keep the affordance out of flex sizing at the existing transcript/composer boundary and retain the geometry regression test so future presentation changes cannot shrink the transcript.

Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue?

Yes, there is a high-confidence reproduction path: on current main, scroll away from the latest message so the conditional flex wrapper appears and compare the transcript/composer geometry before and after. The PR supplies a focused browser test for that path, although this review did not independently execute it.

Is this the best way to solve the issue?

Yes. A zero-height positioned anchor at the existing boundary removes the flex-layout cause directly and is narrower and more maintainable than measuring footer height or introducing another stateful layout path.

AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant.

Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning high; reviewed against [11832b0cee7d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/11832b0cee7d170ed015991e744955060c4097a0).

What I checked:

- **Current-main regression cause:** The conditional affordance wrapper is a flex item with an 8px top margin, so showing it consumes vertical space between the transcript and composer. ([`ui/src/styles/chat/layout.css:124`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/11832b0cee7d/ui/src/styles/chat/layout.css#L124), [11832b0cee7d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/11832b0cee7d))
- **Regression provenance:** Git blame ties the wrapper's flex display and margin to the recently merged centered-affordance implementation. ([`ui/src/styles/chat/layout.css:126`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/454196952a55/ui/src/styles/chat/layout.css#L126), [454196952a55](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/454196952a55))
- **Root-cause repair:** The PR makes the wrapper a zero-height flex item and absolutely positions the control from the existing transcript/composer boundary, without adding runtime measurement or state. ([`ui/src/styles/chat/layout.css:125`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/642fed81e0c5/ui/src/styles/chat/layout.css#L125), [642fed81e0c5](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/642fed81e0c5))
- **Geometry regression coverage:** The new browser test records transcript and composer geometry before the control appears, then verifies both positions remain unchanged and the control stays above the composer. ([`ui/src/e2e/chat-flow.e2e.test.ts:1834`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/642fed81e0c5/ui/src/e2e/chat-flow.e2e.test.ts#L1834), [642fed81e0c5](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/642fed81e0c5))
- **Direct visual proof:** The linked before image shows the control occupying a separate block, while the after image shows the smaller floating control without moving the composer boundary. ([`ui/src/styles/chat/layout.css:133`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/642fed81e0c5/ui/src/styles/chat/layout.css#L133), [642fed81e0c5](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/642fed81e0c5))
- **Related merged history:** The linked merged PR introduced the centered affordance and credits Vyctor H. Brzezowski as co-author; this PR is a focused follow-up to that implementation. ([`ui/src/pages/chat/chat-view.ts:304`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/454196952a55/ui/src/pages/chat/chat-view.ts#L304), [454196952a55](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/454196952a55))
